verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs say users operate Kimi Code Desktop and the CLI through conversation. The agent reads code, edits files, runs commands, searches the web and completes tasks from natural-language chat, and the kimi.com assistant invites users to just ask or start an Agent task. Community reports confirm people use it this way through the Kimi CLI and as a planning assistant. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the natural-language command surface beyond overview-level descriptions, and independent hands-on corroboration that operating the product itself by natural-language commands works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
